Pakistan Protests Soaring Fuel and Grocery Prices, Blame IMF

Protests erupted in Pakistan over sharp increases in petrol and grocery prices, with demonstrators expressing anger towards the International Monetary Fund (IMF). The protests specifically targeted a fuel levy and placed the government of Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif under fire. The slogan "To hell with you and your IMF" was reportedly chanted by protesters.
